schema_compatibility.posts_json: Compatible with data/archive/2026-11-15/posts.json: post_date_et, window, count, sort, fetched_at_et, prepared_at_et, posts[]. Fields per post: id, url, handle, name, text, text_markdown, created_at, created_at_et, metrics.{impression_count,reply_count,like_count,repost_count,quote_count,bookmark_count}, warranty_class, warranty_note. 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-13 also include additive author_id. 2026-11-14 original archive used retweet_count; this public copy maps it to repost_count. Public files omit source, status, delivered_at_et, and internal paths.
schema_compatibility.verification: Compatible with data/archive/2026-11-16/verification.json: topic, fetched_at_et, written_at_et, method, priority_posts, posts[] with n,id,handle,url,promo,coverage,seller_post,seller_comment,landing,third_party,conflicts,missing. This package keeps verification beside the post day (data/archive/YYYY-MM-DD/verification.json) rather than a next-day folder; either layout is mergeable if the site keys off post date or file name.
